name: Basilica of Our Lady Help of Christians
history: Benedictine monks founded Belmont Abbey and made their buildings from local red clay bricks. Leo XIII raised the priory to an abbey in 1884, and its first abbot, Leo Haid, became the first American abbot-bishop in 1888. The abbey church was built from 1892 to 1894 and dedicated on 11 April 1894. It became a basilica in 1998.
arch: A cruciform Gothic Revival brick church with a steep gable roof and two front towers of unequal size.
features: A Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes was dedicated as a pilgrimage shrine in 1891.
The monks run Belmont Abbey College.

look.d: The two front towers are deliberately different sizes.
The monks' day is set by the bells of the abbey church.

fun: The monks made the abbey's bricks from local red clay.
journal: Benedictine brick in the Carolina piedmont. Two towers that don't match, on purpose.
